decisive_items: compound heterozygous sequence variation in GGCX gene
Low clotting activity of factor X (52.2%; reference range, 77%-131%)
Prolonged prothrombin time (12.8 seconds; reference range, 10.4-12.6 seconds)
response.rationale: R1 uniquely integrates the definitive GGCX compound heterozygosity with low factor X and prolonged PT, explaining both the PXE-like calcific elastosis and the coagulopathy. R2 matches the skin and histopathology but omits the genetic and coagulation evidence and would misattribute the cause to ABCC6-type PXE. R4 only captures laxity/elasticity and is contradicted by yellowish papules, elastic-fiber calcification, and the GGCX variant.

rejected.why: Only severe skin sagging and loss of elasticity are supportive; it does not explain yellowish coalesced papules, von Kossa-positive elastic fiber calcification, factor X deficiency, or the GGCX variant.
